integrity.checker: verify_edge.py checks exact half-t identities and independent finite-sample numerical diagnostics; experiments do not prove the universal theorem

scientific_limitations: Requires iid alternating positive run durations with finite mean, regularly varying survival exponent greater than one and polynomial near-zero probability control.
Assumes an athermal harmonic force, identical positive and negative run laws, and a stationary equilibrium-renewal clock.
Only cumulative support-edge asymptotics are established; no density asymptotic, finite-sample estimation or infinite-mean stationary claim.
title: A universal logarithmic support-edge law for a heavy-tailed confined run-and-tumble particle
